tools.name: run_tool_batch
tools.description: Run one or more of the supported tools in order. Each operation has a tool name and an args object. One confirmation authorizes the full batch.

tool.description: Name of one of the supported tools.

args.description: Always Pass only the arguments required by the selected operation.

cmd.description: Windows command to execute. Can be either a Command Prompt (CMD) command or a PowerShell command. For multiline files, use shell-appropriate syntax: in CMD, write the first line with > file echo first line and append further lines with >> file echo next line; in PowerShell, join an array of lines with [Environment]::NewLine. `n is literal inside PowerShell single-quoted strings.

query.description: Search query based on the user's request. Can be rephrased or optimized for better search results if needed.
